=== PAGE 1 ===
DURABLE POWER OF ATTORNEY

I, Robert James Johnson, of San Diego County, California, hereby appoint my brother, Thomas Johnson, as my attorney-in-fact (my "Agent") to act for me in any lawful way with respect to the following matters: banking and brokerage transactions, retirement plans, real property, tax matters, and claims and litigation.

DURABILITY. This power of attorney shall not be affected by my subsequent incapacity. It is effective immediately and shall continue until revoked by me in writing.

SUCCESSOR AGENT. No successor agent is named.

THIRD-PARTY RELIANCE. Any third party who receives a copy of this document may rely on it until the third party has actual knowledge of its revocation.

This document is governed by the laws of the State of California.

Signed on September 9, 2014.

/s/ Robert James Johnson
Robert James Johnson, Principal

State of California, County of San Diego
Subscribed and acknowledged before me on September 9, 2014.
/s/ Gerald Moss, Notary Public
